Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_phase_g.py (38 tests) covering date_utils.normalize_iso unit cases, POST /api/events canonicalization + GET /api/events past-filter, GET /api/digest/preview (auth/400/shape/market-override/empty-flag/parity with scheduler.compute_digest_payload), GET /api/admin/events (403 anon, 403 non-admin, 200 admin, past hidden, PATCH round-trip, sort order), and the startup normalization migration (verified with SMN_ALLOW_RESTART=1 -> legacy date-only starts_at/ends_at rewritten to canonical UTC + 'normalized ISO timestamps on N legacy events' log line present). Full regression across all phase suites: 248 passed / 1 failed / 10 skipped. Frontend: /digest (anon redirect, 400 no-market, crew+event+comment rendering, opt-in toggle + PATCH persistence across reload), /admin/events (non-admin gate, 30 event cards, invalid-email rejection, staging + unsaved pill, save, reload persistence, chip removal, Enter-to-add), and Feed Avatar (dead URL -> onError -> '⛵' fallback with 0 , emoji avatar renders as emoji, outer circle stays 36x36 = h-9 w-9 and is fully contained inside the post card). Only 1 backend assertion failed and it is a spec-vs-implementation conflict (see below); all frontend assertions passed.

minor.issue: SPEC CONFLICT: the review request states 'create with ends_at=now-1h -> hidden', but list_events compares against today_iso (date-only, '2026-08-21'). An event with ends_at='2026-08-21T04:45:00+00:00' string-compares >= '2026-08-21' and therefore stays visible for the rest of the calendar day. Test tests/test_phase_g.py::TestCreateEventCanonical::test_ended_one_hour_ago_hidden fails. The code comment says this is deliberate (keep same-day events visible all final day). Decide which behaviour is intended: if intra-day precision is wanted, compare against datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() (and use start-of-today only as a fallback for date-only rows); if the current behaviour is intended, update the spec and I will flip the assertion.

30 event cards render with no search/filter or market grouping; scanning for a specific event is tedious.

action_items: Resolve the GET /api/events past-filter spec conflict: either switch the $expr comparison to full now-ISO precision (so an event that ended 1h ago is hidden) or confirm the 'visible until end of day' behaviour and I will update the assertion.

Adopt the shared <Avatar> component in Header.jsx, Profile.jsx, CrewBank.jsx, Reviews.jsx, CrewBankModal.jsx, OpenCrewSlots.jsx and PostComments.jsx so dead picture URLs never render a broken-image glyph.
Design polish on /digest (Delivery card placement + use a Switch) and /admin/events (disabled Save contrast, add a filter).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup migration scans the ENTIRE events collection on every boot (db.events.find({}) with no filter/projection guard on already-canonical rows). It is idempotent but O(N) per restart; add a filter such as {'$or': [{'starts_at': {'$regex': '^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$'}}, {'starts_at': {'$regex': 'Z$'}}, ...]} or a one-shot migration marker doc.

admin_router.admin_list_events duplicates the past-event $expr predicate from community_router.list_events. Extract it into a shared helper (e.g. aggregator.upcoming_event_predicate) so the two endpoints can never drift.

normalize_iso silently returns unparseable input unchanged (fail-open). POST /api/events therefore accepts starts_at='not-a-date' and stores it verbatim, which then sorts/filters unpredictably. Consider rejecting with 400 when normalize_iso returns a value that does not parse as a datetime.

date_utils.normalize_iso uses `if value in (None, '')` — for a datetime/date argument this invokes __eq__ against '' which is fine today, but an explicit `if value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip())` is safer.

DigestPreview.jsx has no loading state on the toggle beyond `disabled={busy}`; a failed PATCH shows a toast but the checkbox already reflects the old value correctly — OK, but the optimistic setData happens after await so no rollback needed. No action required, noted for completeness.

rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/events (community_router.list_events:141-153) builds today_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat() -> '2026-08-21' and filters with $expr {$gte: [{$ifNull: ['$ends_at','$starts_at']}, today_iso]}. Because mongo compares these as strings, any full ISO timestamp on the current calendar day ('2026-08-21T04:45:00+00:00') is lexicographically greater than '2026-08-21', so events that already ended earlier today remain listed. This is a deliberate trade-off to keep date-only same-day events visible, and Phase G's normalize_iso migration removed the date-only rows that made it necessary — so the filter can now safely be tightened to full now-ISO precision if intra-day hiding is desired.
